title: deckstack action-metadata aggregate (DS-113)
description: Read-only aggregate of every action the daemon can run: the closed core step vocabulary (docs/contracts/actions.md §3) plus every registered plugin's manifest actions (docs/contracts/plugins.md §3, §9). Served by the opt-in loopback /preview debug surface (docs/contracts/preview.md) at GET /preview/api/action-metadata and embedded in the /preview page and the WS snapshot. The document is derived on demand — never stored, never mutates state, never bumps rev.

protocol.description: Aggregate wire version; additive-only like the control protocol (docs/contracts/ipc.md §2).

generated_at_ms.description: Daemon clock (ms since the Unix epoch) when the aggregate was built.

core.description: The closed core step vocabulary of docs/contracts/actions.md §3 — exactly these five, no others are valid in a binding step.

args.description: Argument fields of the step (name -> short description).

capability.description: Scope/capability the step requires (mutate, admin scope + /policy/exec allow/deny, none).

plugins.description: One entry per registered plugin, built from its manifest (/plugins/<id>/manifest).

capabilities.description: The plugin's granted capabilities (enforced per request/effect by the host, plugins.md §9).

actions.description: The manifest's actions[] verbatim (id, name, description, params JSON Schema).

params.description: JSON Schema for the action arguments, verbatim from the plugin manifest; invoke args are validated against it (E_SCHEMA on mismatch).

capability.description: What invoking this action requires: mutate scope (plugins.md §9) plus the plugin-level capabilities above.
